name: Ballard Sheet Metal Works Inc.
old_description: Since 1907, we are a leader of excellence, offering flashing fabrication, backsplashes, corner guards, sill pans, thresholds, countertops with or without welded-in sinks, custom sink fabrication, custom hoods, fire place surrounds, custom built barbecues, planter boxes, railings, stairs, awnings, chimney caps, along with vast marine work including fire dampers, custom HVAC, welding, tanks and any custom component imaginable. Sheared to size materials are also available.
about:
Ballard Sheet Metal Works Inc. has operated from Seattle, Washington, since 1907. The family-owned and operated business began over a century ago on Ballard Avenue Northwest, serving the Greater Puget Sound area with custom metal fabrication.

The shop provides a wide range of fabrication services, including flashing, backsplashes, corner guards, sill pans, thresholds, countertops with integrated sinks, custom sinks, hoods, fireplace surrounds, barbecues, planter boxes, railings, stairs, awnings, and chimney caps. It also handles marine projects such as fire dampers, custom HVAC components, welding, and tanks. Shearing capacity runs from 24‑gauge material up to 3/8‑inch steel sheet at 10‑foot lengths, and the company works with galvanized steel, hot‑ and cold‑rolled steel, aluminum, prepainted steel, stainless steel, copper, zinc, Cor‑Ten, brass, and diamond plate. Certified welders perform both shop and field welding, and field measurement and installation are available.

Customers include local contractors, architects, and residential homeowners across the Puget Sound region. The company’s marine work serves the maritime industry, while its HVAC and architectural metalwork support commercial and residential construction. Reviews highlight projects for homeowners needing custom countertops, fireplace surrounds, and boat repairs.

The firm emphasizes its team’s experience and the ability to handle projects of any size, from small residential jobs to large commercial contracts. Its long history and in‑house fabrication and installation capabilities are cited as key differentiators.
